notes.zh:
降低 App 自动保存频率：有改动时每五分钟保存，系统返回或进入后台立即保存。
手机高斯优先显示整个场景的轻量泼溅，简化颜色与分辨率并补偿抽样覆盖；编辑按需加载完整数据。
精简项目首页，管理与维护折叠，底部提供 Sen2Maker 和项目链接。
兼容 nativeApi 6，可热更新，无需重新安装 App。
notes.en:
Dirty projects save every five minutes, plus immediately on Back or background.
Mobile Gaussian viewing uses lightweight scene-wide splats with reduced color/resolution and sample coverage compensation. Full editing loads on demand.
A simpler project home with collapsed management, maintenance and author/project links.
Compatible with native API 6: web update only, no APK reinstall.
